title: Častnoe neoficial'noe pis'mo i teksty-rassuždenija. Persoenlicher Briefwechsel und Eroerterungen auf Russisch
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: The purpose of the present exercise book is to expand the ability to write letters using authentic text examples and to deepen it through a rich exercise system. Special emphasis is placed on the teaching of linguistic variants in order to enrich the expressiveness.
